From the actual flight paths of each trip, the theory predicts that the flying clocks, compared with reference clocks at the U.S. Naval Observatory, should have lost 40 \u00b1 23 nanoseconds during the eastward trip, and should have gained 275 \u00b1 21 nanoseconds during the westward trip.
